ui.error.sourceChanged.zh-CN: 文件已发生变化，请重新选择文件后重试。
ui.error.sourceChanged.en-US: The file has changed. Select it again and retry.

ui.error.keywordConflict.zh-CN: 关键词正在被其他操作修改，请稍后重试。
ui.error.keywordConflict.en-US: Another operation is modifying the keywords. Try again shortly.

ui.error.directoryPath.en-US: A browsing result is outside the requested folder.

ui.error.sourceIdentity.en-US: Unable to verify the source file identity.

ui.error.sourceIndex.zh-CN: 文件所在磁盘尚未入库，请先建立目录索引
ui.error.sourceIndex.en-US: The disk containing this file is not indexed. Create a folder index first.

ui.error.localPath.en-US: Only local disk paths are supported.

ui.error.links.zh-CN: 不跟随链接或重解析点
ui.error.links.en-US: Links and reparse points are not followed.

ui.error.sourceRefresh.zh-CN: 源文件已变化，请刷新后重试
ui.error.sourceRefresh.en-US: The source file has changed. Refresh and try again.

ui.error.sourceReplaced.en-US: The source file has been replaced.

ui.error.directoryQuery.en-US: The folder is unavailable for queries.

ui.error.fileSelection.zh-CN: 请选择不超过十万项的文件或目录。
ui.error.fileSelection.en-US: Select no more than 100,000 files or folders.

ui.error.metadataDirectory.zh-CN: 请选择目录以提取元数据。
ui.error.metadataDirectory.en-US: Select a folder to extract metadata.

ui.error.directoryMissing.zh-CN: 目录不存在或当前不可用
ui.error.directoryMissing.en-US: The folder does not exist or is currently unavailable.

ui.error.fileLimit.en-US: You can process up to 200 items at a time.

ui.error.fileBusy.zh-CN: 已有文件操作正在进行
ui.error.fileBusy.en-US: A file operation is already in progress.

ui.error.trashResults.zh-CN: Core 删除结果不属于本次选择
ui.error.trashResults.en-US: The Core deletion result does not belong to this selection.

ui.error.keywordReload.zh-CN: 关键词已在其他窗口变化，请重新读取后再编辑
ui.error.keywordReload.en-US: The keywords changed in another window. Reload them before editing.

ui.error.setupMissing.zh-CN: Core 安装组件缺失，请重新安装或解压完整程序包。
ui.error.setupMissing.en-US: The Core setup component is missing. Reinstall the app or extract the full package.

ui.error.setupStart.en-US: Unable to start the Core setup tool.

ui.error.nativeUnavailable.en-US: The native Core component is unavailable.

ui.error.nativeLimit.en-US: The operation content exceeds the limit.

ui.error.metadataDisconnected.zh-CN: Core尚未连接，请先重新连接。
ui.error.metadataDisconnected.en-US: Core is not connected. Reconnect first.

ui.error.metadataCapability.zh-CN: 当前 Core 不支持属性提取，请重新安装完整程序包。
ui.error.metadataCapability.en-US: This Core does not support metadata extraction. Reinstall the full application package.

ui.error.connectionChanged.en-US: The Core connection has changed. Try again.

ui.error.metadataConnection.zh-CN: Core连接已改变，请刷新任务状态。
ui.error.metadataConnection.en-US: The Core connection has changed. Refresh the task status.

ui.error.batchConnection.zh-CN: 后台连接已改变，请重新开始提取。
ui.error.batchConnection.en-US: The background connection has changed. Start extraction again.

ui.error.rpcQueue.en-US: The Core request queue is full.

ui.error.rpcRequest.en-US: The Core request exceeds the frame limit.

ui.error.rpcResponse.en-US: Core returned an invalid response frame.

ui.error.imagePath.en-US: The Core image is outside the cache directory.

ui.error.autoInvalid.zh-CN: 模型未返回有效关键词，请重试。
ui.error.autoInvalid.en-US: The model did not return valid keywords. Try again.

ui.error.autoLimit.zh-CN: 现有关键词已接近数量上限，请整理后重试。
ui.error.autoLimit.en-US: The existing keywords are near the limit. Remove some keywords and try again.

ui.error.keywordLimit.zh-CN: 关键词超出限制，请减少数量或缩短内容后重试。
ui.error.keywordLimit.en-US: The keywords exceed the limit. Use fewer or shorter keywords and try again.

ui.error.browseCapacity.zh-CN: 递归浏览超出限制。请检查磁盘索引，或关闭“包含子文件夹”。
ui.error.browseCapacity.en-US: Recursive browsing exceeds the limit. Check the disk index or turn off Include subfolders.

ui.error.favoriteOrder.zh-CN: 收藏列表已变化，请取消后重新调整位置
ui.error.favoriteOrder.en-US: The favorites list has changed. Cancel and reorder it again.

ui.error.pageCursor.zh-CN: 后续结果暂时无法加载，请点击刷新后继续浏览。
ui.error.pageCursor.en-US: More results could not be loaded. Refresh to continue browsing.

ui.error.scopeRebuild.zh-CN: 请在“设置 → 缓存与索引”中选择该磁盘，点击“建立 / 更新”以重建索引。
ui.error.scopeRebuild.en-US: Select this disk under Settings → Cache & index and click Build / update to rebuild its index.

ui.error.scopeRebuildRandom.zh-CN: 随机浏览前需要重建索引。请在“设置 → 缓存与索引”中选择该磁盘，点击“建立 / 更新”。
ui.error.scopeRebuildRandom.en-US: Random browsing requires rebuilding the index. Select this disk under Settings → Cache & index and click Build / update.

ui.error.scopeBuilding.zh-CN: 索引建立中，暂时无法搜索和筛选，仍可直接浏览。
ui.error.scopeBuilding.en-US: The index is being built. Search and filters are unavailable; direct browsing is available.

ui.error.scopeBuildingRandom.zh-CN: 索引建立中，暂时无法随机浏览，仍可直接浏览。
ui.error.scopeBuildingRandom.en-US: The index is being built. Random browsing is unavailable; direct browsing is available.

ui.error.scopeRandom.zh-CN: 随机浏览需要就绪的索引。请在设置中检查索引状态；仍可直接浏览。
ui.error.scopeRandom.en-US: Random browsing requires a ready index. Check index status in Settings. Direct browsing is available.

ui.error.scopeUnavailable.zh-CN: 索引尚未就绪，暂时无法搜索和筛选。清除搜索和筛选后可直接浏览。
ui.error.scopeUnavailable.en-US: The index is not ready for search or filters. Clear search and filters to browse directly.

ui.error.autoGeneric.zh-CN: 自动添加关键词失败，请检查目录索引、本地模型和源文件后重试。
ui.error.autoGeneric.en-US: Unable to add keywords automatically. Check the folder index, local model and source file, then try again.

ui.error.autoCancelling.zh-CN: 正在取消；已保存的关键词会保留。
ui.error.autoCancelling.en-US: Cancelling. Keywords already saved will be kept.

ui.error.autoPartial.zh-CN: 部分目录未能完整读取，请确认目录已入库且可访问。
ui.error.autoPartial.en-US: Some folders could not be read completely. Make sure they are indexed and accessible.

ui.error.exclusionDirectory.en-US: The exclusion is not a folder: {path}

ui.error.setupFailed.zh-CN: Core 配置未完成，请检查管理员授权及 .NET 10 x64 运行时。详情见诊断信息。
ui.error.setupFailed.en-US: Core setup did not complete. Check administrator approval and the .NET 10 x64 runtime. See diagnostics for details.

ui.error.backgroundDisconnected.zh-CN: 后台同步已断开，列表已保留。请刷新；仍失败时，到诊断页重新连接。
ui.error.backgroundDisconnected.en-US: Background sync disconnected. The list is kept. Refresh; if it still fails, reconnect on the Diagnostics page.

ui.preview.mediaFailed.zh-CN: 媒体播放失败，请使用默认程序打开。
ui.preview.mediaFailed.en-US: Media playback failed. Open the file in its default app.

ui.preview.formatFailed.zh-CN: 格式预览失败，已显示源码：{error}
ui.preview.formatFailed.en-US: The formatted preview failed. Showing source: {error}

ui.preview.pinFailed.en-US: Unable to save the pinned state: {error}

ui.preview.textTruncated.en-US: Text truncated at the preview limit

ui.preview.truncatedEncoding.zh-CN: 正文已按 1 MiB 上限截断 · {encoding}
ui.preview.truncatedEncoding.en-US: Text truncated at the 1 MiB limit · {encoding}

ui.preview.archiveTruncated.zh-CN: 列表已截断，当前显示 {count:N0} 项
ui.preview.archiveTruncated.en-US: The list is truncated. Showing {count:N0} items

ui.preview.fontLimit.zh-CN: 字体文件超过预览范围。
ui.preview.fontLimit.en-US: The font file exceeds the preview limit.

ui.preview.textDisplayFailed.zh-CN: 正文显示失败，请重新打开文件。
ui.preview.textDisplayFailed.en-US: Text could not be displayed. Reopen the file.

ui.preview.fontLoadFailed.en-US: The font could not be loaded.

ui.preview.animationDisplayFailed.zh-CN: 动图显示失败，请使用默认程序打开。
ui.preview.animationDisplayFailed.en-US: The animation could not be displayed. Open it in the default app.

ui.preview.animationDecodeFailed.zh-CN: 动图解码失败，请使用默认程序打开。
ui.preview.animationDecodeFailed.en-US: The animation could not be decoded. Open it in the default app.

ui.accessibility.resizeHelp.zh-CN: 拖动调整宽度；双击恢复默认；方向键每次调整 16 DIP
ui.accessibility.resizeHelp.en-US: Drag to resize; double-click to reset; arrow keys adjust by 16 DIP

ui.sidebar.reorder.en-US: Drag to reorder; use Alt+↑/↓ to adjust

ui.error.metadataService.zh-CN: 元数据服务未连接，请到“诊断 → 服务维护”中重新连接。
ui.error.metadataService.en-US: The metadata service is disconnected. Reconnect under Diagnostics → Service maintenance.

ui.error.metadataIndex.zh-CN: 请先建立可用的目录索引，再提取元数据。
ui.error.metadataIndex.en-US: Create a queryable folder index before extracting metadata.

ui.error.metadataScope.zh-CN: 当前目录索引尚未就绪，请先在设置中建立或更新索引。
ui.error.metadataScope.en-US: The current folder index is not ready. Build or update it in Settings first.

ui.error.metadataVolumes.zh-CN: 没有可提取的已选索引磁盘，请先检查目录索引。
ui.error.metadataVolumes.en-US: No selected indexed disks are available for extraction. Check the folder indexes first.

ui.error.metadataExclusion.zh-CN: 无法安全定位排除目录：{path}
ui.error.metadataExclusion.en-US: Unable to safely resolve the excluded folder: {path}

ui.error.filterResource.en-US: The advanced filter resources are invalid.

ui.taskNotifications.counts.zh-CN: 已处理 {processed} 项，成功 {succeeded} 项，失败 {failed} 项，跳过 {skipped} 项。

ui.taskNotifications.failed.zh-CN: 任务失败，请打开 Cap7CE 查看详情
ui.taskNotifications.failed.en-US: Task failed; open Cap7CE for details

ui.notice.notificationsBlocked.zh-CN: Windows 已禁止此应用发送通知，请检查系统通知设置。
ui.notice.notificationsBlocked.en-US: Windows is blocking notifications from this app. Check system notification settings.

ui.shortcuts.conflict.zh-CN: 组合键被占用或被 Windows 拒绝，其他快捷键不受影响。
ui.shortcuts.conflict.en-US: Shortcut in use or rejected by Windows. Other shortcuts are unaffected.

ui.shortcuts.invalid.zh-CN: 组合键不可用，请重新设置。

ui.shortcuts.duplicate.zh-CN: 已用于其他操作，请先清除原绑定。
ui.shortcuts.duplicate.en-US: Assigned to another action. Clear the existing binding first.

ui.shortcuts.unavailable.en-US: The shortcut service is not ready

ui.shortcuts.captureHint.zh-CN: 按下组合键后应用；Esc 取消，Tab 切换按钮。
ui.shortcuts.captureHint.en-US: Press a shortcut, then Apply. Esc cancels; Tab moves between buttons.

ui.shortcuts.action.cycleDirectory.zh-CN: 循环此电脑与收藏目录
ui.shortcuts.action.cycleDirectory.en-US: Cycle This PC and favorite folders

ui.shortcuts.action.restoreDefaultWindow.zh-CN: 恢复窗口默认位置与大小

ui.shortcuts.action.toggleFavorite.zh-CN: 添加或取消文件夹收藏

ui.shortcuts.action.openSelected.zh-CN: 用默认应用打开选中项

ui.shortcuts.action.aiKeywords.zh-CN: 为选中项生成 AI 关键词

ui.diagnostics.exported.zh-CN: 已导出，日志采集情况已附在包内。
ui.diagnostics.exported.en-US: Exported. Log collection details are included.

ui.diagnostics.notification.blocked.zh-CN: 未获系统允许或未注册

ui.settings.referenceOnly.zh-CN: 在主窗口搜索框输入指令，按回车执行。
ui.settings.referenceOnly.en-US: Enter a command in the main window search box and press Enter to run it.

ui.exclusions.hint.zh-CN: 勾选的目录及其子目录将跳过批量提取。
ui.exclusions.hint.en-US: Checked folders and their subfolders are skipped during batch extraction.

ui.shortcuts.resetHint.zh-CN: 恢复可自定义快捷键的默认键位。通用操作使用固定键位。
ui.shortcuts.resetHint.en-US: Restore defaults for customizable shortcuts. Common actions use fixed keys.

ui.model.serviceDescription.zh-CN: 启动或停止本地 AI 服务。
ui.model.serviceDescription.en-US: Start or stop the local AI service.

ui.diagnostics.statusHint.zh-CN: 查看后台连接、读取服务、边缘模式和通知状态。
ui.diagnostics.statusHint.en-US: View background connection, Reader service, edge mode, and notification status.

ui.command.invalid.zh-CN: 指令或参数无效，请查看设置中的快捷指令。
ui.command.invalid.en-US: Invalid command or arguments. See Quick commands in Settings.

ui.command.confirm.zh-CN: {action} 输入 y 确认、n 取消后按回车；Esc 取消。
ui.command.confirm.en-US: {action} Enter y to confirm or n to cancel, then press Enter. Esc cancels.

ui.command.runtimeFailed.zh-CN: 服务操作未成功，请检查本地 AI 状态。
ui.command.runtimeFailed.en-US: The service operation did not complete. Check local AI status.

ui.command.stopBeforeSelect.zh-CN: 请先停止本地 AI 服务，再切换版本或模型。
ui.command.stopBeforeSelect.en-US: Stop the local AI service before changing version or model.

ui.command.uniqueMatch.zh-CN: 未找到唯一匹配项，请使用完整路径或准确名称。
ui.command.uniqueMatch.en-US: No unique match was found. Use a full path or exact name.

ui.command.standardWindow.zh-CN: 此操作仅在标准窗口模式下可用。
ui.command.standardWindow.en-US: This action is available only in standard window mode.

ui.command.directory.zh-CN: 请输入存在的目录完整路径。
ui.command.directory.en-US: Enter the full path of an existing folder.

ui.command.confirmRemove.zh-CN: 取消收藏“{name}”？目录及文件不会删除。
ui.command.confirmRemove.en-US: Remove “{name}” from favorites? The folder and its files are kept.

ui.command.confirmStop.zh-CN: 停止本地 AI 服务？下次生成 AI 关键词时需重新启动。
ui.command.confirmStop.en-US: Stop the local AI service? It must restart for the next AI keyword task.

ui.command.confirmCache.zh-CN: 是否清理缩略图与预览缓存？保留源文件、索引和关键词。
ui.command.confirmCache.en-US: Clear thumbnail and preview caches? Source files, indexes, and keywords are preserved.

ui.tray.enabledHint.zh-CN: 在托盘显示应用图标，关闭窗口时后台运行。
ui.tray.enabledHint.en-US: Show the app icon in the system tray and keep running when the window is closed.

ui.tray.showStartupHint.zh-CN: 关闭后程序每次将在后台启动。
ui.tray.showStartupHint.en-US: When off, the app starts in the background each time.

ui.tray.failed.zh-CN: 托盘图标不可用，已显示主窗口。可在设置中重新开启。
ui.tray.failed.en-US: The tray icon is unavailable. The main window is shown. Re-enable the tray icon in Settings.

ui.rename.hint.en-US: Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel.

ui.rename.selectionHint.zh-CN: 不支持系统位置、超过200项、收藏目录或其上级目录。
ui.rename.selectionHint.en-US: System locations, more than 200 items, and favorite folders or their parents are not supported.

ui.rename.invalidSelection.zh-CN: 无法重命名当前选择。请勿同时选择目录及其内部项目。
ui.rename.invalidSelection.en-US: Cannot rename this selection. Do not select a folder together with items inside it.

ui.rename.invalidName.zh-CN: 名称无效。请检查非法字符、保留名称及结尾的空格或句点。
ui.rename.invalidName.en-US: Invalid name. Check for invalid characters, reserved names, or trailing spaces or periods.

ui.rename.invalidResult.zh-CN: 重命名结果校验失败，请刷新目录确认实际名称。
ui.rename.invalidResult.en-US: Could not verify the rename result. Refresh the folder to check the actual names.

ui.rename.failed.zh-CN: 有{count}项未能重命名，请检查占用、权限或名称冲突。
ui.rename.failed.en-US: Could not rename {count} items. Check for locks, permissions, or name conflicts.

ui.rename.batchDescription.zh-CN: 统一名称，保留扩展名，由系统自动编号。
ui.rename.batchDescription.en-US: Use one base name, keep extensions, and let Windows number the items.

ui.error.accessDenied.zh-CN: 没有操作权限，请检查文件或目录权限。
ui.error.accessDenied.en-US: Access denied. Check file or folder permissions.

ui.error.fileMissing.zh-CN: 文件不存在或已移动，请刷新后重试。
ui.error.fileMissing.en-US: The file is missing or has moved. Refresh and try again.

ui.error.operationTimeout.en-US: The operation timed out. Try again.

ui.error.operationFailed.zh-CN: 操作未完成，请重试；仍失败时，请查看诊断信息。
ui.error.operationFailed.en-US: The operation did not finish. Retry; if it still fails, check diagnostics.
